newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China to attend UN hearing on HK human rights.
newsitem.headline: China to attend UN hearing on HK human rights.

text.p: China plans to attend a UN hearing that will scrutinise Hong Kong's human rights record, the South China Morning Post reported on Sunday.
Beijing had agreed to send observers to the hearing in Geneva on October 23, the newspaper quoted Francisco Aguilar Urbina, chairman of the UN Human Rights Committee (UNHRC), as saying.
China was also considering attending a UN committee hearing on economic, social and cultural rights on November 26, the paper said.
Urbina and other UNHRC members could not be immediately contacted for comment.
China resumes sovereignty over the British colony at midnight on June 30, 1997, and some in Hong Kong fear Beijing will curb basic freedoms and democracy in the free-wheeling territory.
